scope: Real shared Go handler through httptest, normal session cookies, GORM and disposable in-memory SQLite. Concurrent batches use simultaneous handler goroutines sharing this fixture database.
limitations: No TCP, standalone static server, native PostgreSQL, pgx, Encore runtime, production deployment, or actual browser was exercised.
The SQLite bridge has one database connection; simultaneous handler results do not certify PostgreSQL row locking, deadlocks, pool behavior, or multi-instance concurrency.
Amounts are checked at the HTTP boundary; exact decimal input parsing and rendered financial reports require the separate frontend suite.
This records fictional external payment references only; no money transfer, banking integration, tax calculation, or reconciliation is performed.
details: Finance requests use the normal authenticated session boundary
New companies receive INR, April fiscal year, starter categories, and empty transaction arrays
All eight role scenarios receive the specified financial scope
Finance role does not acquire company, department, or membership administration
Finance manages versioned categories; stale and head category writes are rejected
Budget amounts reject fractional, negative, and over-limit values while accepting zero
Inclusive budget overlap is rejected even for draft envelopes and shared boundary dates
Budget references, fiscal-year boundaries, and management permissions are enforced
Company currency and fiscal-year month freeze after financial records exist
Activated budget scope is immutable and allocation revisions require a reason
Personal scopes omit budget totals and viewers receive no financial arrays
Expense money validates exact integer minor units and the documented upper boundary
Future expense dates are rejected in the company timezone without changing a draft version
Financial text limits count Unicode characters and preserve valid multilingual boundary values
Clients cannot forge creator, currency, code, version, or workflow at expense creation
Expense references cannot cross tenants; creators remain in their allowed department
Company financial visibility does not expose hidden task/project links
Finance role cannot use an expense link to acquire task write permission
Expense identity, creator, currency snapshot, draft state, and exact amount are server supplied
Case and whitespace variations cannot duplicate a non-void vendor/invoice pair
Expense editing is creator-only and cannot change tenant or creator identity
Approval cannot skip submission and required evidence blocks submission
Safe receipt bytes persist and append advances the expense version
Authorised receipt download preserves bytes and attachment security headers
Receipts enforce expense scope, company scope, and creator/finance upload permission
Submitted financial decision fields freeze until withdrawal or rejection
Newly appended evidence invalidates an approval based on an older expense version
Independent head approves an in-scope expense inside the active budget
Stale approval cannot repeat and creator cannot void their approved expense
Receipt exception requires an explicit independent approval note of meaningful length
Founder and finance authority both remain unable to approve, reject, or pay their own expense
Payment recording checks authority, payment method/reference, and company-local date bounds
Recording payment moves approved value to paid without double counting budget use
Duplicate payment clicks and all attempted paid-record edits or voids are rejected
Personal financial reads contain only the immutable creator’s expenses
Department heads cannot see other department expenses or events
Reasoned allocation revisions persist and stale budget writes conflict
Submitted requests are pending and do not reserve or double-count available budget
Simultaneous handler approvals recheck shared budget capacity: exactly one fits
Only company finance authority can approve overspend with a meaningful explicit override
Reasoned allocation below used value preserves commitments and exposes negative availability
A draft budget does not authorise spending; absence of an active budget needs company override
Department and personal scope exclude another department’s financial records
Closed budgets require an explicit company override despite sufficient numeric capacity
Closing and reopening require reasons; activated budgets never return to draft
Rejected expense can be corrected and resubmitted; withdrawal returns it to draft
Void is final; independent approved void releases exactly the prior commitment
Archived category blocks new entries while preserving existing expenses and their amounts
Financial decisions, overrides, payments, receipt additions, and budget revisions retain scoped audit events
Financial payment and override details do not leak into broad task activity feeds
Role changes immediately narrow financial read scope and revoke financial management writes
Revoked membership cannot read finance or execute a mutation using its existing cookie
Receipt and payment history survive category archival and actor role changes
